instrument: Child and Adolescent Mindfulness Measure original 10-item
missing_policy: complete required per score, otherwise null; product convention
source_note: Official PDF scoring page: 'First reverse all scores by changing 0 to 4, 1 to 3, 3 to 1, and 4 to 0 (2 stays unchanged). Then sum all items. Higher scores correspond to higher levels of mindfulness.' CAMM is unidimensional; all 10 items are reverse-scored (4 - response) and summed to one total in 0-40, presented here as the single dimension mindful_awareness with no separate total key and no invented subscales.
